title: The Player Grabber 2000
features:
This script is not mine but I accidentally found abuse in the game when using this script, which allows you to take people like ordinary gubbies and throw them 

HOW ITS WORKS
After you become a flying cube by pressing "Z", you cannot pick up people. However, you cannot do this to old players who were on the server before you. Only players who have just joined can be picked up.

To be able to pick up players who were on the server before you, they need to be killed. The Fling help you with this player collisions are enabled. After that you will be able to pick up that player that's all you need nothing complicated Have fun.



P.S.: You do not become invisible to other players. To them, you appear as a flying ragdoll.
